rejected_rule.statement: A share in a well cannot be acquired by prescription, and a right to take water along a watercourse on the servient land can be established only upon a special grant or clear evidence of prescriptive user.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: But there is no deed establishing that any of these rights had been acquired by the plaintiffs or their predecessors either by purchase or grant from the owner of the servient tenement. But the law does not contemplate that a share in a well can be acquired by prescription. A right to take water along a watercourse on the servient land can be established only upon a special grant or by clear evidence of prescriptive user.
